items.titleEn: The role of the office in front of Friday Quraysh in the killing of De Mahan, the case of the national revolution in Kurdistan
items.summaryEn: Information and reports received by Iran International indicate that security and military forces of the office of Imam Juma Quru in Kurdistan Province, during the repression of the National Revolution of 1404, were involved in shooting people and children.

items.title: زلنسکی: آمریکا ایده عقب‌نشینی از دونباس در ازای عضویت اوکراین در ناتو را مطرح کرد
items.summary: ولودیمیر زلنسکی، رییس‌جمهوری اوکراین، پس از آخرین دور مذاکرات صلح با روسیه اعلام کرد هیات آمریکایی ایده عقب‌نشینی اوکراین از منطقه دونباس را در ازای عضویت این کشور در ناتو مطرح کرده است.
items.titleEn: Zelensky: The United States has proposed withdrawing from Donbass in exchange for Ukraine's NATO membership.
items.summaryEn: Vladimir Zelensky, President of Ukraine, announced after the last round of peace talks with Russia that the US delegation had proposed the idea of withdrawing Ukraine from the Donbass region in exchange for its NATO membership.
